Lurker using a throwaway account. Just want to give my advice to you all. Reddit does not look at your browser history (some social media sites do, but that's another discussion), they are simply checking which site you are coming from

Do not, I repeat, DO NOT, directly click on a link to Reddit from Voat, or to/from anywhere from that matter.

There's a function called HTTP referrer, which lets them know which site you followed that link from. Originally created for server admins and webmasters to see what other sites their users frequent to better cater to their interests, it is now used by advertising agencies to build consumer profiles and by sites like Reddit to censor wrongthink, with the excuse of preventing "brigades".

You can still follow links, just COPY the link and paste it into the URL of a NEW tab or window. That way, there is no HTTP referrer string sent. DO NOT paste it into the current tab/window, as this will function the same as if you had just clicked the link.

Yes, this takes longer, but it's only 1-3 seconds. We all have the patience to watch what we eat and work out, you can take the time to ensure you won't be subjected to this kind of underhanded censorship by a cuck reddit admin again.

Edit: Read the thread a bit, noticed someone already brought this up and suggested disabling the function, but I disagree with that. HTTP referral serves a legitimate purpose, and should be left on for sites that respect their userbase, like Voat. Just take the extra moment to copy and paste the link for shitty sites like Reddit. Think of it like walking down the airport terminal instead of using those big "people mover" treadmills.
